name: A — Momentum rotation
idea: Stocks that rose most over 3–12 months tend to keep outperforming for months.

name: B — Trend and breakout
idea: Ride strong trends, cut losers early; few big winners pay for many small losses.

name: C — Pullback in an uptrend
idea: In a rising stock, short dips tend to recover within days.
watch: A dip that turns into a crash; many trades, so charges matter.

name: D — Price patterns (Python)
idea: Classic chart setups the visual rules cannot express.
watch: The code assumes its own signal was filled; if no slot was free, it may wait for its own exit before signalling again.

name: E — Low turnover
idea: Hold strong stocks for months; fewer trades, more long-term (12.5%) tax.
watch: Long holds sit through deep falls before the exit rule sells.

name: F — Baselines
idea: The bar every strategy must beat.
watch: Not meant to pass: they show what doing nothing clever earned.

name: G — Intraday, 1-minute to 1-hour (MIS, testing)
idea: Same-day moves after the open, squared off from 15:20 (D46).
watch: Needs 1m history; 3m–1h are built from it. Charges apply; slippage, spread and impact are not modelled. Coarse bars cannot reproduce exact 15:20 fills. Intraday tax is not estimated.
